summary: Completed comprehensive frontend-only testing for SajiloHealth 'Coming Soon' landing page. All 14 review checkpoints passed. No console errors. Language toggle, anchor scroll, form validation, localStorage persistence, success state, and Sonner toast all work correctly. Layout is responsive at 1920x1080 and 375x800 without horizontal overflow.

issues: Privacy and Terms links both anchor to #trust (placeholder behavior). Acceptable for coming-soon page but should point to real pages eventually.

critical_code_review_comments: Footer Privacy/Terms both link to #trust — placeholder; replace with real routes before public launch.
Header nav id 'trust' label says 'Why Nepal' — copy matches mapping correctly; just verify intent.
BetaForm uses setTimeout(600ms) as a fake submit delay — fine for FE-only; consider replacing once a backend exists.
i18n copy file is large (~300 lines) but cohesive; splitting per-section could improve maintainability if it grows.
seed_data_creation: None. Form writes to localStorage key 'sh_leads'; verified persistence during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All review_request checkpoints verified end-to-end with Playwright against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Validated: header visibility (brand, 4 nav links, EN/NE toggle, Join Beta CTA), hero (eyebrow/headline/subheadline/paragraph/2 CTAs), primary CTA scrolls to #beta (URL becomes /#beta and beta-section in viewport), secondary CTA scrolls to #clinics, all 4 nav links anchor-scroll, NE toggle changes copy ('बिरामीहरूका लागि') and persists via localStorage 'sh_lang' across reload, EN restores English, patients=4 / doctors=4 / clinics=5 items + brand tile, 3 trust points, footer visible with copyright/tagline/3 links, empty submit shows email+role errors, invalid email shows error, valid submission shows success state + Sonner toast, lead stored in 'sh_leads', no horizontal overflow on mobile (375x800), 0 console errors.
